legal.title: ⚖️ Legal Notice
legal.note: This calculator is for reference only; actual severance pay may vary.
legal.item1: We use the standard calculation formula according to the Employee Retirement Benefit Security Act.
legal.item2: The actual average wage includes all wages (base salary, allowances, bonuses, etc.) received over the past three months.
legal.item3: In complex cases such as interim settlement or calculation of continuous employment period, please consult with a labor attorney.
legal.item4: Those who have worked for less than one year are not eligible for severance pay.
